note: Parameters of the VIRTUAL BEAMLINE (blade.vbl) built on this twin. Everything here that is not in hutches/*.json is an ASSUMPTION needed to make the simulation run: distances other than the 12 known ones, hidden 'truth' ranges, camera sensors. Each block says where a number comes from (log = read in the experiment logs, code = mpe_bluesky, twin = this twin's JSON, assumed = chosen here, to be replaced by a survey/drawing). Nothing here is a hardware setting; the simulator never talks to hardware.

z_m._note: metres from the source. known: twin (z_conf code). assumed: interpolated between the known anchors in panel order; replace with surveyed values when available.

source.size_src: log: focused beam 30 (h) / 17-23 (v) um FWHM in brightness / regular mode (2026 Feb); used here as the effective source size that sets the geometric penumbra of every slit edge
source.beam_sigma_src: fit 2026-11-13: 0.147 +- 0.009 mm (3 within-session WB-slit flux ratios agree to 1 %; H and V not separable; fits/flux.md)
source.steering_urad_to_mm_at_E: u = xp * z; 1 urad = 0.07 mm at 71.6 m

undulator.period_src: fit 2026-11-13: refit of period + K(g) on 88 logged (gap, n, E) rows, n=5-11, 8.5-11.3 mm, 0.115 % rms in E (physics/fits/source.md); period 20.95 +- 0.47 (device U21). Only valid 8.5-11.3 mm
undulator.gap_limit_src: log: gap limit 8.75 mm (Jan 2025), but Pr (41.99 keV, n=5) was peaked at 8.54 mm in 2026 and the model puts that harmonic at 8.5 mm: limit lowered to 8.5 | history (fits/source.json): 8.82 Nov 2024, 8.75 Jan 2025, 8.80 Jul 2025, 8.5 Jun 2026
undulator.hysteresis_src: log: scans from a closing direction do not overlay those from open; 'open to ~9.5 mm first' (M24:L56-69); size assumed
undulator.gap_wander_src: fit 2026-11-13: peak-gap wander 0.0009 mm within a session, 0.0092 mm between sessions (88 rows, fits/source.md)
undulator.steering_src: log: best WB-slit centre moves with the ID setting (L23:L218-278); size assumed
undulator.k_coef_src: fit 2026-11-13: B0[T] = a exp(b g/lambda_u), (a, b, c) = (2.6701, -3.2966, 0) (c unconstrained, fixed 0); physics/fits/source.json

flux_model.src: blade.physics.undulator.harmonic_amplitude (Kim flux factor of the harmonic at its own gap) ^ exponent. 2026-11-13: exponent 0.67 REFIT inside this function with the fitted k_coef so that the 7th/5th flux ratio at 61.3 keV = 3.07 (logged 2.95-3.2; the 0.74 in fits/source.json belongs to source_fit.harmonic_amplitude_fit, a different normalisation). One ratio only: PENDING more flux-vs-harmonic data (fits/source.md). Harmonic choice 13/13 at the logged energies

undulator.rel_fwhm_src: fit 2026-11-13: relative FWHM of the flux-vs-gap peak ~0.98 %, n-independent (ASSUMED from the one logged ~0.07-0.1 mm at n=7; fits/source.md); replaces the per-harmonic scaling

hem.th2_src: assumed 2 mdeg, inside the range the logs allow (0.6-6 mdeg; Darwin prior 0.31 mdeg; fits/mono.md)

thermal.src: log: first crystal heats +3 K at 0.4x0.4 mm and +10 K at 0.8x0.7 mm; flux recovers after thermalisation and a Th2 tweak (T26:L318-424). Coefficients assumed | 2026-11-13: th2_shift_deg_per_kW 0.004 -> 0.0009 so that a cold->hot WB 0.3x0.3 detuning (0.49 mdeg x 0.3 coupling) gives the ~7 eV dump shifts logged (sd 9 eV, 2-12 eV; fits/mono.md). tau 420 s still ASSUMED (no relaxation series in the logs)

hem.edge_width_src: fit 2026-11-13: wid(E) = E * 22.8e-6 / tan(theta_B) on 7+ logged edge fits, rms 4.1 eV (fits/mono.md); natural vs instrumental width not separable
hem.th2_coupling_src: log: a Th2 tweak moved mu_t 1.299 -> 1.334 at Re (user log, Mar 2025); size assumed

ic.ref_src: log: IC_B1 = 174-178.5 kHz at 200 mA, 50 nA/V, WB 0.3x0.3 mm, Au/Re edge
ic.dark_src: fit 2026-11-13: per-IC dark floors from startup tables (IC4-E 0.928, not 0.35); ICs not listed keep dark_kHz (fits/flux.md)
ic.icB1_gain_note: the IC reading is flux x gain; gains are 1 here for all ICs (the real preamp settings are not recorded)
ic.flux_vs_energy_src: fit 2026-11-13: IC_B1/B3 rates at a tuned chain relative to 71.7 keV (7 knots, 10-25 % uncertainty, cross-session scatter 20-30 %; fits/flux.md). Replaces the constant 176 kHz at every energy. NOT modelled: preamp gain (rate ~ gain^-0.955), IC gas/length

slits._note: Kohzu 4-blade slits as soft axes hsize/vsize/hcenter/vcenter (mm). zero = hidden offset between the slit coordinate and the lab beam axis (what 'aligning the slit' removes). Limits and resolution assumed.

slitEds.center_src: twin snapshot (centres hidden in the photo)

slits.zero_src: log: hotspot vs WB-slit image centre differs by 10-20 um (steering/WB nudges of 10-20 um); the Kohzu slit zeros are re-set to the hotspot every energy change and sit up to 0.9 mm from the beam (offsets of 0.03-0.9 mm in the final slit tables): spreads assumed accordingly
slits.hsign_note: slit centre sign convention is an OPEN question in the twin; +hcenter moves the opening toward +u (image right) here

lenses._note: Saw-tooth stacks of hutch E (physics: blade.physics.lens.LENSES_1ID). axis: th/phi decides vertical/horizontal focusing (blade.physics.lens.focus_motor_target). 'in' means the lens x motor is at 0, 'out' at x_out mm.
lenses.truth_src: log: measured optima differ from the predicted tilts by 0.002-0.010 deg

foils.attenB_src: fit 2026-11-13: 11 wheel positions from the macro help (cm -> mm): Cu 0, 0.1016, 1.016, 1.52, 2.13; Pb 1.5, 3.0, 5.0; Cu 6.2, 2.0, 9.0. Entries are mm of Cu or [material, mm]. One transmission check (x1.031 thickness) not applied (fits/flux.md)
foils.attenC_src: fit 2026-11-13: 8 positions, ~2.35 mm Cu per step, 16.45 mm at position 7 (macro help; was assumed [0,0.5,1,2]) (fits/flux.md)
foils.b_src: fit 2026-11-13: logged E_scan edge steps b (mu_t above minus below the K edge) per element, fits/mono.json; Pr 1.0 unchanged (assumed)

cameras._note: Tomo cameras. pixel_um comes from the profile (profiles/s1id). Sensor sizes: gh1 1490x1940 (test data), pg1 1920x1200 and pg5 1920x1200 (ImageJ titles in the logs), retiga2 assumed. bg/full/texture/dust/halo calibrated on the log screenshots (dark floor 0.5-1.5 kcounts, mottle +-15-30 %, fixed-pattern dust, 1-5 % scatter halo).

pg1.note: Point Grey 1920x1200 (the ImageJ view in the logs is often an 1184x1200 ROI); 5.86 um sensor pixels

pg5.note: 1idSP5 in the log images (profile: hutch C); structured speckled beam

tomo_stages._note: x = horizontal translation, y = vertical (mm). Operators zero x,y on the hotspot, so the beam is near x = 0 (+-1 mm, moves with steering/energy); limits and out positions from the logs. Sign (+x moves the field of view toward +u) is assumed.

tomoC.src: log: tomoC x 1idc:m79 Lo -224.985 Hi 31.0, in = 0, out ~ -225..-250 (parked at -224.98: just inside the soft limit -224.985+; -225.0 was rejected by the simulator's own limit check); y 1idc:m84

tomoE.src: log: tomoEus x 1ide1:m63 range -1..283.8, in = 0, out ~150 (Img X 150 = out); y m40 -21.3..8.0

tomoB.src: assumed (B-TOM limits not in the logs)

stage_E._note: Hutch E rotation stage. Signs are the hardware-confirmed ones of the profile (2026-10-28). Pin = BLADE alignment pin (dark truncated cone).

pin.top_width_src: 151.5 px x 0.69 um in the 1490x1940 test frames
pin.transmission_src: test frames gave 0.045 at the top; the log screenshots show 8-20 % interior transmission with the thicker lower part darker; 0.06 at the top flat is used and the interior darkens as T^((width/top width)^0.35)

truth.src: test-data values: axis column 818 px vs beam centre 972 px, a=-132 px, b=-10 px (0.69 um/px)

truth_scales.src: assumed spreads for the random 'startup' scenario (log: steering corrections of 2-6 urad; gap peak wanders 0.004-0.07 mm; Th1 offset drifts 0.5 mdeg) | 2026-11-13: gap_err 0.01 mm (rms of the refit model vs 88 logged peak gaps, fits/source.md); th1_err 1.5 mdeg = rms about zero of the legacy-era readback offset N(1.2, 1.0) mdeg from 43 E_scan fits (post-Jul-2026 reset era: N(0.19, 0.22); fits/mono.md)

fast_shutters.src: log: FS is 3.0 mm wide in X and 1.7 mm in Y; its centre is found from the blade edges on the tomo (user log, Feb 2026) | 2026-11-13: vsize 1.7 -> 1.69 +- 0.16 (fits/flux.md); aligned-shutter leakage ~8e-5 of the open beam is not modelled
